name: OmaBlinker
author: Jay O
description: A blinking drive-activity LED for the Omarchy bar, lit by real block-layer I/O events captured with an eBPF tracepoint program — just like the activity LED on an old PC tower. Optionally splits into a green/red Read/Write pair, or further into a blue/green/red Cache Hit/Read/Write trio. Run this plugin's install.sh (see its README) after every install, enable, AND update — `omarchy plugin update` alone does not rebuild or reinstall the privileged daemon.

barWidget.description: Blinks whenever the kernel block layer reports disk I/O.
